nodes.summary: Let $\theta(x) = \sum_{p \le x} \log p$ be Chebyshev's function, the sum running over primes $p$, and let $H(t) = \theta(e^t)e^{-t} - 1$ be the normalized theta error. Then $|H(t)| \le \log 4 + 1$ for every real $t$.
nodes.title: Explicit bound for the normalized theta error

nodes.summary: Let $\theta(x) = \sum_{p \le x} \log p$ be Chebyshev's function, the sum running over the primes $p \le x$. Then the Laplace transform $F(s) = \int_{(0, \infty)} e^{-st}\,\theta(e^t)\,dt$ of $t \mapsto \theta(e^t)$ is complex differentiable at every point of the open half-plane $\{s \in \mathbb{C} : \operatorname{Re} s > 1\}$, so it is holomorphic there.

nodes.summary: Let $\theta(x) = \sum_{p \le x} \log p$ be Chebyshev's function, the sum running over the primes $p \le x$. For every $s \in \mathbb{C}$ with $\operatorname{Re} s > 1$, the Laplace transform $\int_{(0, \infty)} e^{-st}\,\theta(e^t)\,dt$ of $t \mapsto \theta(e^t)$ at $s$ equals $\frac{1}{s} \sum_p \log p \cdot p^{-s}$, the prime logarithm series at $s$ divided by $s$, where the sum runs over all primes $p$.

nodes.summary: Let $\Phi(s) = \sum_p \frac{\log p}{p^s}$ be the prime logarithmic Dirichlet series, summed over all primes $p$, and let $G$ be the prime logarithmic continuation. Then $G(s) = \Phi(s) - \frac{1}{s - 1}$ for every complex number $s$ with $\operatorname{Re} s > 1$.
nodes.title: The prime logarithmic continuation on the half-plane $\operatorname{Re} s > 1$

nodes.summary: The prime logarithmic continuation $G$ is analytic at every point of the closed half-plane $\{s \in \mathbb{C} : \operatorname{Re} s \ge 1\}$.
nodes.title: Analyticity of the prime logarithmic continuation

nodes.summary: The prime logarithmic continuation $G$ is meromorphic on the open half-plane $\{s \in \mathbb{C} : \operatorname{Re} s > 1/2\}$.
nodes.title: Meromorphy of the prime logarithmic continuation

nodes.summary: For a complex number $s$, the prime logarithmic continuation is $G(s) = -\frac{\zeta_1'(s)}{\zeta_1(s)} - C(s)$, where $\zeta_1$ is the entire function with $\zeta_1(s) = (s - 1)\zeta(s)$ for $s \ne 1$ and $\zeta_1(1) = 1$, the quotient is taken to be $0$ where $\zeta_1(s) = 0$, and $C$ is the prime-power correction series.
nodes.title: The canonical prime logarithmic continuation

nodes.summary: The prime-power correction series $C(s) = \sum_{(p, k)} \frac{\log p}{(p^{k+2})^s}$, summed over all primes $p$ and natural numbers $k \ge 0$, is analytic at every point of the open half-plane $\{s \in \mathbb{C} : \operatorname{Re} s > 1/2\}$.
nodes.title: Analyticity of the prime-power correction series

nodes.summary: For a prime $p$, a natural number $k$ and a complex number $s$, the correction summand is $\frac{\log p}{(p^{k+2})^s}$, the term of the prime-power correction series that belongs to the prime power $p^{k+2}$.
nodes.title: Summand of the prime-power correction series

nodes.summary: For a complex number $s$, the prime-power correction series is $C(s) = \sum_{(p, k)} \frac{\log p}{(p^{k+2})^s}$, summed over all pairs of a prime $p$ and a natural number $k \ge 0$ (the sum is taken to be $0$ where the family is not summable).
nodes.title: Prime-power correction series

nodes.summary: Let $\Phi(s) = \sum_p \frac{\log p}{p^s}$ be the prime logarithmic Dirichlet series. There is a function $g : \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$ that is meromorphic on the open half-plane $\operatorname{Re} s > 1/2$, analytic at every point of the closed half-plane $\operatorname{Re} s \ge 1$, and satisfies $g(s) = \Phi(s) - \frac{1}{s-1}$ whenever $\operatorname{Re} s > 1$.
nodes.title: Meromorphic continuation of the prime logarithmic Dirichlet series

nodes.summary: For every complex number $s$ with $\operatorname{Re} s > 1$, $\Phi(s) = -\frac{\zeta'(s)}{\zeta(s)} - C(s)$, where $\Phi$ is the prime logarithmic Dirichlet series, $\zeta$ is the Riemann zeta function and $C$ is the prime-power correction series.
nodes.title: Prime logarithmic series via the logarithmic derivative of zeta

nodes.summary: For a complex number $s$, the prime logarithmic Dirichlet series is $\Phi(s) = \sum_{p} \frac{\log p}{p^s}$, summed over all primes $p$ (the sum is taken to be $0$ where the family is not summable).
nodes.title: Prime logarithmic Dirichlet series

nodes.summary: Let $\theta(x) = \sum_{p \le x} \log p$ be Chebyshev's function, the sum running over primes $p$. The normalized theta error $H(t) = \theta(e^t)e^{-t} - 1$ is a Borel measurable function of $t \in \mathbb{R}$.
nodes.title: Measurability of the normalized theta error

nodes.summary: Let $\theta(x) = \sum_{p \le x} \log p$ be Chebyshev's function, the sum running over primes $p$, and let $H(t) = \theta(e^t)e^{-t} - 1$ be the normalized theta error. There is a real number $M$ such that $|H(t)| \le M$ for every real $t \ge 0$.
nodes.title: Boundedness of the normalized theta error on $(0, \infty)$

nodes.summary: Let $\Phi(s) = \sum_p \log p / p^s$, the sum over primes, let $g$ be the canonical continuation of $\Phi(s) - 1/(s - 1)$, and let $g_1(s) = g(s + 1)$ be the shifted continuation. For $s \in \mathbb{C}$, the normalized-error continuation is $F(s) = (g_1(s) - 1)/(s + 1)$, with $F(-1) = 0$ since division by zero gives $0$.
nodes.title: The normalized-error continuation

nodes.summary: For real $t$, let $H(t) = \theta(e^t) e^{-t} - 1$, where $\theta(x) = \sum_{p \le x} \log p$ is the Chebyshev function, the sum running over primes $p \le x$.

nodes.summary: Let $\pi(x)$ be the number of primes $p \le x$ and let $\theta(x) = \sum_{p \le x} \log p$ be Chebyshev's theta function, the sum running over primes. Then, as the real number $x$ tends to $+\infty$, $\pi(x) \sim x / \log x$ holds if and only if $\theta(x) \sim x$.
nodes.title: Prime number theorem is equivalent to the theta asymptotic

nodes.summary: Let $\pi(x)$ be the number of primes $p \le x$ and let $\theta(x) = \sum_{p \le x} \log p$, the sum running over primes. If $\theta(x) \sim x$ as the real number $x$ tends to $+\infty$, then $\pi(x) \sim x / \log x$ as $x \to +\infty$.
nodes.title: Theta asymptotic implies the prime number theorem

nodes.title: Prime counting versus theta over log

nodes.summary: For $s \in \mathbb{C}$, the prime logarithm series at $s$ is the complex number $\sum_p \log p \cdot p^{-s}$, where the sum runs over all primes $p$ and $p^{-s}$ is the complex power. The sum is unconditional and is taken to be $0$ by convention when the family $(\log p \cdot p^{-s})_p$ is not summable.
nodes.title: The prime logarithm series

nodes.summary: Let $\pi(n)$ be the number of primes $p \le n$. Then $\pi(n) \sim n / \log n$ as $n \to \infty$ through the natural numbers, that is, $\pi(n) - n / \log n = o(n / \log n)$, where $\log$ is the natural logarithm.
nodes.title: Prime number theorem

nodes.summary: Let $\zeta$ be the Riemann zeta function and let $\zeta_1 \colon \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$ be given by $\zeta_1(s) = (s - 1)\zeta(s)$ for $s \ne 1$ and $\zeta_1(1) = 1$. Then $\zeta_1(s) \ne 0$ for every complex number $s$ with $\operatorname{Re} s \ge 1$.
nodes.title: Nonvanishing of the Riemann zeta function times $s - 1$ on $\operatorname{Re} s \ge 1$

nodes.summary: Let $\Phi(s) = \sum_p \log p / p^s$ be the prime logarithmic Dirichlet series and $g_1$ the shifted continuation. For every $s \in \mathbb{C}$ with $\operatorname{Re} s > 0$, $g_1(s) = \Phi(s + 1) - 1/s$.
nodes.title: The shifted continuation agrees with the shifted series

nodes.summary: The shifted continuation $g_1$ is complex analytic at every point $s \in \mathbb{C}$ with $\operatorname{Re} s \ge 0$.
nodes.title: Holomorphy of the shifted continuation on the closed half-plane

nodes.summary: The shifted continuation $g_1$ is meromorphic at every point $s \in \mathbb{C}$ with $\operatorname{Re} s > -1/2$.
nodes.title: Meromorphy of the shifted continuation

nodes.summary: Let $\Phi(s) = \sum_p \log p / p^s$, the sum over primes, and let $g$ be the canonical continuation of $\Phi(s) - 1/(s - 1)$ to $\operatorname{Re} s > 1/2$. For $s \in \mathbb{C}$, the shifted continuation is $g_1(s) = g(s + 1)$.
nodes.title: The shifted log-Dirichlet continuation
